children.name: section_text_alignment
children.label: Section Text Alignment
children.help_text: The horizontal alignment of the text.

children.name: section_background_type
children.label: Section Background Type
children.help_text: Choose the kind of background that displays on the section.

children.name: section_background_image
children.label: Section Background Image
children.help_text: Specify an image to use as the background of the section.

children.name: section_background_image_overlay
children.label: Section Background Image Overlay
children.help_text: Add a layer of color on top of the background image. You can also specify the opacity (e.g. 85%)

children.name: section_id
children.label: Section ID
children.help_text:
Enter a unique ID. This will be used to jump directly on this section.

Note: May require developer/designer assistance.

children.name: section_class
children.label: Section Class
children.help_text:
Add a few extra CSS class on this section so you can customize even further.

Note: May require developer/designer assistance.

children.name: section_use_existing_portal_style
children.label: Section Use Existing Portal Style
children.help_text: Enable this option to use existing portal styling.

children.name: section_show_hide
children.label: Section Show/Hide
children.help_text: Disable this option to hide this section on the page.
